scope: Agentic KGCheck only: all 20 source-dev and 205 source-test records. Atomic KGQA and SCV tasks and retrieval documents are excluded from this task count. Source partitions are metadata; final training still has one train split.
identity_policy: Upstream rows have no explicit ID. Inventory IDs combine KGCheck, source subset and zero-based position in the checksum-pinned JSON; each row also carries its instruction SHA-256.
inspection: All identifiers and source categories enumerated; all ten instruction templates reviewed after replacing accession strings. Three shared workflow patterns assessed. Individual scientific evidence, graph correctness and expected labels remain unassessed.
license_and_lineage: Dataset card and code declare MIT. The project explicitly retains constituent database licenses; this does not license all graph records or literature for redistribution. Only abstract patterns and inventory metadata are retained here. The downloaded task JSON contains graph, evidence and label fields, which are not copied into this inventory or used for training authoring. Large graph tables, literature corpus and atomic suites were not downloaded.

source_grading.review: Final-answer evaluator and graph/database/literature tool implementations inspected, not executed. Shared protocol assessed from KGCheck README, runner and normalized instructions; no model calls.
source_grading.main_metric: Exact match of the final support/refute conclusion to the reference label.
source_grading.supplementary_metric: The README describes a Qwen2-72B process judge; it is not required for the exact-match endpoint and will not be adopted for training rewards.
source_grading.solver_model_dependency: The baseline literature tool calls an LLM to assess documents. A deterministic endpoint does not make the supplied solver or its retrieval tools model-free.
static_code_findings: judge_conclusion aligns submissions and references by list position and instruction equality; it does not enforce complete ID coverage or order-independent alignment.
The exact-match denominator is len(answer), so omitted records reduce the denominator. A new verifier must require the full declared task set.
The final exact-match check does not validate the reason text, citations or retrieved graph evidence.
The existence and relation tools use live UniProt and STRING responses. A new offline task needs pinned snapshots and separate handling of missing records, failed access and genuine refutation.

task_defaults.assessment: Shared instruction pattern reviewed; accession-specific scientific evidence unreviewed. No benchmark answers or fixtures used for authoring.
remaining_gaps: Use independent observed database records and published evidence, with dated releases, constituent licenses and benchmark-lineage screening.
Freeze retrieval inputs for offline execution. Retain access failures and insufficient evidence as distinct outcomes; absence of an annotation does not establish biological absence.
Define complete graph-query, evidence and reconciliation artifacts with deterministic checks; a binary label alone does not validate the workflow.
Validate an input-reading oracle, relevant native tools and corrupted-artifact controls within 30 minutes.

protein-attribute-reconciliation.scientific_decision: Determine whether a graph protein attribute agrees with the corresponding versioned source record.
required_stages: resolve protein identifier, species and source version
query the graph node and requested attribute
retrieve the corresponding database record and distinguish missing fields from missing entries
reconcile naming and identifier changes and preserve the evidence
required_formats: UniProt flatfile or equivalent pinned record
required_tools: Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent reproducible graph queries
scientific_constraints: The baseline treats name as a gene name. Gene symbol, protein name and accession are distinct identifiers and must not be silently interchanged.

database-entry-reconciliation.scientific_decision: Determine whether entity presence agrees between a graph snapshot and a source database snapshot.
required_stages: query node presence in the specified graph release
check source-record presence and documented identifier history
separate missing, obsolete, redirected and inaccessible records and export reconciliation
required_formats: versioned database record and identifier history
required_tools: Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent reproducible graph queries
scientific_constraints: Record deletion or absence is a database-state observation, not proof that a protein does not exist biologically.

directed-relation-evidence.scientific_decision: Check a directed graph relation against its appropriate database or literature evidence.
required_stages: resolve both typed entities and the exact relation semantics
query directed relations, node presence and source provenance
retrieve supporting or contradicting source records and literature when required
distinguish physical interaction, association, localization and inferred annotation
export relation, evidence identifiers and a scoped conclusion
required_formats: typed graph edges and source TSV tables
required_tools: Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent reproducible graph queries
scientific_constraints: STRING association does not by itself establish direct physical binding.
Protein-to-protein, cellular-component, tissue and disease relations have different evidence meanings.
The public prompt asks to confirm absence. An adaptation must scope this to a declared source snapshot or preserve insufficient-evidence outcomes.
